question: What happens if two keys have the same hashCode in a HashMap?
options: One key will overwrite the other
Both will be stored using collision handling
Only one key will be stored
answer: Both will be stored using collision handling
explainer: HashMap uses LinkedList or Tree structure to handle collisions.
